column1: # SmartBoot partition layout for the 8MB Cardputer ADV. This is the starting table;
# SmartBoot adds and removes installed apps (OTA app partitions) and their data
# partitions in the free space between factory and sbnvs at runtime (src/partitions.cpp).
# Our bootloader (bootloader/) starts factory on every power-on
# reachable. sbnvs/sbdata are SmartBoot's private storage: apps never use these labels.
# 0x1C0000 - 0x7EC000 (6.17 MB): free for installed apps and their data
